factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report states: 'customers remain highly price-sensitive, with the majority of transactions involving more affordable apartments'

factual_claims.claim: Against this backdrop, the company’s secured order book grew substantially, reaching EUR 835.7 million as of 30 June 2026, up 88 percent from EUR 443.8 million a year prior.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Secured order book was EUR 835.7 million as of 30 June 2026 vs EUR 443.8 million as of 30 June 2025 (Management Report and Ratios section)

factual_claims.claim: This expansion was fueled by approximately EUR 486.4 million in newly signed contracts, heavily weighted toward public-sector infrastructure and defence-related projects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EUR 486.4 million in new contracts signed in H1 2026 with public sector share increasing due to 'Rail Baltica and defence-related contracts' (Management Report)

factual_claims.claim: Financially, cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 39.6 million, though operating cash flows turned negative at EUR 31.6 million due to seasonal inventory buildup in development projects and shifts in working capital.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash and cash equivalents: EUR 39,593 thousand (39.6 million) as of 30 June 2026. Operating cash flow: -(EUR 31,602 thousand) (-31.6 million) attributed to inventory changes and working capital (Cash Flow Statement and Management Report)

factual_claims.claim: Net debt rose to EUR 29.6 million from a net cash position of EUR 1.1 million the previous year, pushing the debt ratio to 15.8 percent.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net debt was EUR 29.6 million as of 30 June 2026 vs -(EUR 1.1 million) as of 30 June 2025. Debt ratio was 15.8% as of 30 June 2026 (Ratios section)

factual_claims.claim: Total equity stood at EUR 251.1 million, representing 57.4 percent of total assets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Equity was EUR 251,141 thousand (251.1 million) representing 57.4% of total assets as of 30 June 2026 (Statement of Financial Position and Ratios)

factual_claims.claim: Shareholders received dividends of EUR 22.1 million, equivalent to EUR 1.25 per share.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividends paid: EUR 22,125 thousand (22.1 million) or EUR 1.25 per share from 2025 net profit (Dividends and Dividend Policy section)

factual_claims.claim: Overall, the first half reflected stronger forward-looking contract acquisition and resilient long-term balance sheet metrics, tempered by near-term margin compression and a cyclical slowdown in apartment deliveries amid sustained cost inflation.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Summary reflects: strong order book growth (835.7M), improved equity position, but margin pressure from inflation and lower apartment deliveries (Management Report and Financial Highlights)
